structured_output.conclusion:
On the review date, Qorvo's claim against Akoustis was at trial with no verdict. Qorvo claims USD 66.1m in trade-secret damages plus patent, punitive and other relief, and the court has ruled that the jury has no reasonable basis for compensable UDTPA damages.

Akoustis had USD 15.2m of cash at 31 Mar 2024 and discloses substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. It says an adverse judgment would reduce the time it can operate on current cash and could force it to curtail or cease operations and file for bankruptcy.

Under the indenture, uninsured final money judgments above USD 10.0m that remain undischarged, unpaid or unstayed for 60 days after notice are an event of default permitting acceleration of the USD 44.0m notes. Non-listing on an Eligible Market is also an event of default and a Fundamental Change giving holders a cash repurchase right; the Nasdaq bid-price compliance deadline is 21 Oct 2024. Apart from USD 48.0m of ATM capacity, Akoustis has no commitments for additional funds.

The host builds the probabilistic analysis from dispute_001 and financing_001.

Whether an injunction or ongoing royalty is ordered, and the share of BAW filter receipts affected (fact_003)
Redacted patent royalty and unfair-competition damages figures, and Akoustis's expert avoided-cost figure
Cash realisable under the USD 48.0m ATM after a verdict and in light of the 21 Oct 2024 Nasdaq bid-price deadline
